summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no files changed) I traced the full chain end to end before proposing a fix: - `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` — loads via `GET /watchlist`, saves via `POST/DELETE /watchlist/:id/items`. No localStorage/sessionStorage fallback, no anonymous state. Uses the shared `api` client. - `client/src/lib/api.ts` — every request sets `credentials: "include"`, so cookies are sent consistently; no client-held token to go stale. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` — has its own `watchlistRouter.use("*"
